title: The Semester of the quarry
author: Odile Nystrom
blurb: Felix Montrose, the only out kid in a town of nine hundred, stays under the radar: head down, grades up, locker shut. Then grandma's recipe box contains directions that aren't for food — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must tell the truth even if it costs the friendship before graduation.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
